verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal and SFTP client, so a built-in way to clone Git repositories falls outside its product category. A user could run git inside a remote or local shell, but that is the host's capability, not Termius's. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius shipping its own Git cloning feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
